clips.sourceTitle: 高位下拉 · 正手宽握开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按照教学的背面斜角拍摄，保持头部、手臂、横杆和髋部入镜。不要将此示范当作反手、对握或颈后下拉。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the rear-oblique view with your head, arms, bar and hips in frame. This is an overhand pulldown, not an underhand, neutral-grip or behind-neck variant.

clips.sourceTitle: 高位下拉动作讲解 · 正手宽握从 02:09 开始
哑铃侧平举动作教学 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按照教学中的正面斜角拍摄，保持头部、双手和髋部完整入镜；这是手动对比，不是自动动作评分。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the tutorial's front-oblique angle, keeping your head, hands and hips in frame. Comparison is manual, not automatic form scoring.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃侧平举动作教学
船长椅椅直举腿 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范的正面略偏侧角度拍摄，船长椅、双前臂支撑和双腿完整可见；此为谭师指导学员的支撑直腿举腿，不是双手悬垂版。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly oblique front view. Keep the captain's chair, forearm supports and both legs visible. Tan Sir coaches a student performing supported straight-leg raises, not bar-hanging raises.

clips.sourceTitle: 卷腹地面 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范的斜上方角度拍摄，头肩、躯干、屈膝和双脚都留在画面内；教学画面为谭师指导学员，双脚不离地。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the diagonal elevated view. Keep the head, shoulders, torso, bent knees and feet visible. Tan Sir coaches the student with both feet planted.

clips.sourceTitle: 健腹轮滚动 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范侧面略偏前角度拍摄，将健腹轮、躯干、髋部和跪地双膝放进画面；采用能控制的推出距离，示范为谭师指导学员的跪姿版本。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Include the wheel, torso, hips and grounded knees. Use a controllable rollout distance; Tan Sir coaches a kneeling student.

clips.sourceTitle: 绳索后踢臂屈伸 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 从示范的斜侧方拍摄，拍全肩、肘、手和绳索；俯身后保持上臂稳定，只通过伸肘向后伸直。示范使用较高的滑轮位置。
clips.framingNoteEn: Use the same oblique side angle and include the shoulder, elbow, hand and cable. Hinge forward, keep the upper arm steady and extend the elbow backward. The demonstration uses a higher pulley position.

clips.sourceTitle: EZ杠仰卧窄握三头肌臂屈伸颈后 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 从头端斜侧方拍摄，拍到平板凳、双肩、双肘和整根EZ曲杆，保留杆下降至头后的路径；不要拍成下斜凳或卧推。
clips.framingNoteEn: Film obliquely from the head end, including the flat bench, shoulders, elbows and entire EZ bar so the behind-head path remains visible. Do not substitute a decline bench or a chest press.

clips.sourceTitle: EZ杠弯举 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按照示范侧面略偏后角度拍摄，保持站姿、肩肘、双手和EZ曲杆完整可见；谭师指导学员，上臂尽量稳定，以可控制的重量完成弯举。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the rear-oblique side view, keeping the standing posture, shoulders, elbows, hands and EZ bar visible. Tan Sir coaches a student; keep the upper arms steady and use a controllable weight.

clips.sourceTitle: 绳索反握下拉 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 照教学前半段从侧后方斜拍：坐姿、反手握长杆，把双手、肘部、背部和杆的完整轨迹拍进画面。后半段切到侧面讲解；同屏对比时先对齐前半段连续示范，不必跟随镜头切换。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the rear three-quarter view in the first half: sit down, hold the long bar with an underhand grip, and keep both hands, elbows, back and the full bar path visible. The second half switches to side-view explanation; align your comparison with the continuous demonstration before that cut.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃卧推 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范从斜侧方拍摄，完整拍到平板凳、双肩、双肘和两只哑铃；保持双脚稳定落地。
clips.framingNoteEn: Film from the same oblique side angle, keeping the flat bench, both shoulders, elbows and dumbbells visible; keep your feet planted.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃坐姿三头肌臂屈伸 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范的侧面角度拍摄，坐姿躯干、双肘和整个哑铃都留在画面里；双手托住同一只哑铃，保持躯干稳定。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the side view. Keep the seated torso, both elbows and entire dumbbell visible. Both hands support the same dumbbell while the torso stays stable.

clips.sourceTitle: 胸部臂屈伸 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范的正面略偏侧角度拍摄，将双杠、双臂、躯干及悬空双脚纳入画面；使用能控制的下降幅度，胸部不适时不要强行继续。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly oblique front view. Include both parallel bars, arms, torso and suspended feet. Use a controllable descent and do not force continuation if the chest feels uncomfortable.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃高脚杯深蹲 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按照示范的侧面略偏前角度拍摄，胸前竖握的哑铃、躯干、双膝和双脚都在画面内；谭师在旁指导学员完成动作。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Include the vertically held chest-level dumbbell, torso, both knees and feet. Tan Sir coaches the student.

clips.sourceTitle: 杠铃罗马尼亚硬拉 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范的侧面略偏前角度拍摄，整根杠铃、髋部、双膝和双脚保持可见；从站立开始屈髋下放再回到站立，不必让杠铃落地。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Keep the whole barbell, hips, knees and feet visible. Start upright, hinge downward and return upright without needing to place the bar on the floor.

clips.sourceTitle: 背屈伸 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范侧面略偏前角度拍摄，将45度挺身凳、髋部支撑垫、躯干和脚踝固定位置纳入画面；示范为无额外负重版本，手臂可自然放下。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Include the 45-degree back-extension bench, hip pad, torso and ankle restraints. This is an unloaded variation with the arms hanging naturally.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃罗马尼亚硬拉 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按照示范的侧面略偏前角度拍摄，全身、双脚和两只哑铃都留在画面内；展示从站立到屈髋再站起的完整过程。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Keep your full body, both feet, and both dumbbells visible, including the full standing-to-hinge-to-standing cycle.

clips.sourceTitle: 器械坐姿飞鸟 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 照教学从正前方略偏侧面拍摄，坐在器械上、背部靠垫，拍到胸部、双手、两侧器械臂和打开到合拢的完整轨迹。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the front three-quarter view. Sit with your back against the pad and keep your chest, both hands, both machine arms and the full open-to-close path visible.

clips.sourceTitle: 器械坐姿反向飞鸟双杠握 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 照教学从背后略偏侧面拍摄，胸部贴靠垫，双手握竖向把手；让双肩、双肘、双手和器械两侧运动轨迹都入镜。教学后段镜头略向侧面移动，对比时优先对齐背面连续示范。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the rear or rear three-quarter view with your chest against the pad and a neutral grip on the vertical handles. Keep both shoulders, elbows, hands and both machine arms visible. The camera moves toward the side near the end; align comparison with the rear-view repetition first.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃单腿分腿蹲 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范的侧面略偏前角度拍摄，前脚、放在凳上的后脚、双手哑铃及整个躯干保持可见；教学画面为谭师指导学员完成动作。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Keep the front foot, elevated rear foot, both dumbbells and torso visible. This clip shows Tan Sir coaching a student.

clips.sourceTitle: 器械俯卧腿弯举 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范的侧面略偏前角度拍摄，俯卧器械、髋部、双膝和脚踝滚垫都留在画面内；教学画面为谭师指导学员完成动作。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Keep the prone machine, hips, both knees and ankle roller visible. This clip shows Tan Sir coaching a student.

clips.sourceTitle: 绳索直背部坐姿划船 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 照教学从侧前方斜拍，坐在低位划船器械上、双脚踩脚踏、双手对握把手；完整拍到双手、肘部、躯干、双膝及绳索轨迹。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the side-front three-quarter view. Sit at the low cable row, place both feet on the footrests and use a neutral grip. Keep both hands, elbows, torso, knees and the cable path visible.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃坐姿肩上推举 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 照教学从侧前方斜拍，坐稳并让躯干保持稳定；拍到座椅、双脚、双肘、双手和哑铃从肩上推到头顶的完整路径。此真人示范有靠背，动作库动图为无靠背坐姿，重点对照前臂和哑铃推举轨迹。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the side-front three-quarter view. Sit securely with a stable torso and include the seat, feet, elbows, hands and full shoulder-to-overhead dumbbell path. The source uses a backrest while the animation is unsupported seated; focus comparison on the forearm and press path.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃前平举2 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 照教学从侧前方斜拍，站姿、双手对握哑铃，同时向前平举；拍到躯干、双肩、双肘和双手的上下路径，保留完整哑铃位置，不要让最高点超出画面。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the side-front three-quarter view. Stand and raise both dumbbells forward together using a neutral grip. Keep your torso, shoulders, elbows and the full hand path visible, with enough room for both dumbbells at the top.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃上斜卧推举 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范从头端斜侧方拍摄，拍全上斜凳、双肩、双肘和两只哑铃；凳背约30–45度，保持双脚落地。教学强调顶端保留轻微肘弯维持张力。
clips.framingNoteEn: Film obliquely from the head end, keeping the incline bench, shoulders, elbows and both dumbbells visible. Use roughly a 30–45 degree backrest and planted feet. The lesson keeps a slight elbow bend at the top to maintain tension.

clips.sourceTitle: 杠铃卧推 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 这是谭师与凯圣王共创指导学员的片段。按照头端斜侧方拍摄，拍全平凳、杠铃、双肩和双脚；保留杠铃下降到胸部并推起的完整路径。
clips.framingNoteEn: This is coached trainee footage from the Tan Sir / Kai Sheng Wang collaboration. Film obliquely from the head end, including the flat bench, barbell, shoulders and feet, with the full lowering-to-chest and pressing path visible.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃上斜二头肌弯举 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 谭师指导学员的上斜哑铃弯举。按示范斜侧方拍摄，拍到上斜凳、肩肘与两只哑铃；保持胸廓和肩部稳定，展示伸肘下降与弯举的完整循环。
clips.framingNoteEn: Tan Sir coaches a trainee performing incline dumbbell curls. Use the same oblique side view and include the incline bench, shoulders, elbows and both dumbbells. Keep the chest and shoulders stable and show complete lowering and curling cycles.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃后弓步 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按照示范侧面略偏前角度拍摄，双手哑铃、双膝和双脚全程留在画面内；每次向后迈一步，下蹲后收回后脚，再换另一侧。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Keep both dumbbells, knees and feet visible. Step backward, lower into the lunge, return the rear foot to standing, then alternate sides.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃站姿三头肌臂屈伸 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范的侧后方角度拍摄，双手共同托住的一只哑铃、双肘、躯干及站立姿势保持可见；控制屈伸，避免过度向前顶腰。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the rear-oblique view. Keep the single dumbbell supported by both hands, elbows, torso and standing posture visible. Control elbow bending and extension without excessive lower-back arching.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃后飞鸟 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范侧面略偏前角度拍摄，将坐凳、双手哑铃、躯干和双脚纳入画面；采用坐姿俯身飞鸟，并控制下放，避免哑铃在地面上完全卸力。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Include the seat, both dumbbells, torso and feet. Perform the seated bent-over fly and control the lowering without completely unloading the dumbbells on the floor.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃交替二头肌弯举 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范侧面略偏前角度拍摄，将双手哑铃、双肘、整个躯干和站立姿势纳入画面；交替屈肘弯举，保持上臂稳定，避免向后甩肘。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Include both dumbbells, elbows, torso and standing posture. Alternate elbow curls while keeping the upper arms stable without swinging the elbows backward.

clips.sourceTitle: 哑铃俯身划船 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按照谭师示范的斜侧方拍摄，拍全头部、脊柱、髋膝和两只哑铃；保持俯身姿势，展示双臂同步划船与缓慢下降，不用挺胸起身借力。示范握把略有斜角。
clips.framingNoteEn: Use Tan Sir's oblique side view and include the head, spine, hips, knees and both dumbbells. Maintain the hinged torso while showing simultaneous rows and controlled lowering without standing up to assist the lift. The demonstrated handles are slightly angled.

clips.sourceTitle: 弹力带辅助引体向上 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 从谭师示范的正后方拍摄，拍全双手、单杠、整个身体、弹力带和脚部。视频示范双脚踩带、用踏台进入，动图为套膝辅助变式；手动对比请按照视频的双脚踩带方式，不混用两种带位。这不是无辅助引体。
clips.framingNoteEn: Film directly from behind and include both hands, the bar, whole body, band and feet. The video demonstrates both feet in the band with platform entry; the GIF uses knee-loop assistance. For manual comparison, follow the video's two-foot band placement and do not mix the two placements. This is not an unassisted pull-up.

clips.sourceTitle: 绳索站姿飞鸟 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范正面略偏侧角度拍摄，双侧高位滑轮、手柄、双肘和躯干保持可见；从身体两侧向前下方合拢，控制回放。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly oblique front view. Keep both high pulleys, handles, elbows and torso visible. Bring the handles forward and downward from your sides and control the return.

clips.sourceTitle: 器械上斜胸推2 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范侧面略偏前角度拍摄，上斜靠背、两侧推臂和手柄、双肘及躯干保持可见；背部贴住靠背，控制推起与回放。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Include the inclined backrest, both press arms and handles, elbows and torso. Keep your back supported and control pressing and lowering.

clips.sourceTitle: 杠铃站姿窄握站姿推举 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范侧面略偏前角度拍摄，整根杠铃、握距、双肘、躯干和双脚保持可见；使用示范较窄握距，杠铃从上胸附近向头顶推起，避免塌腕和腿部借力。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly front-oblique side view. Include the whole barbell, grip width, elbows, torso and feet. Use the demonstrated close grip, press from the upper chest overhead, and avoid wrist collapse or leg drive.

clips.sourceTitle: 绳索过头三头肌臂屈伸绳配件 · 真人示范与指导 · 开发节选
clips.framingNoteZh: 按示范正面略偏侧角度拍摄，将低位滑轮、绳索、双肘和整个躯干留在画面内；背对器械，保持躯干稳定，双肘屈伸让绳索从头后向上移动。
clips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly oblique front view. Include the low pulley, rope, elbows and torso. Face away from the machine, keep the torso stable and extend both elbows to move the rope upward from behind the head.
